finding.summary: Non-manifold closed shell: four straight edges (x = +-1.225 mm, z = 1.08 mm) each bound four faces, where two lobes of the switch touch along a line. MANIFOLD_SOLID_BREP requires each edge to bound two faces, so the retained-boundary reader refuses it as invalid. OpenCascade's BRepCheck does not test manifoldness and accepts it.
